properties.title: total_supply_equals_sum_of_balances
properties.description: sDAI totalSupply equals the sum of balanceOf over all accounts.
properties.group: Share accounting is exact and fully backed

properties.title: shares_equal_pot_pie
properties.description: The normalized savings balance pie that the Pot records for the sDAI contract equals sDAI totalSupply: every share is backed by exactly one unit of pie and no pie is unaccounted for.
properties.group: Share accounting is exact and fully backed

properties.title: pot_total_pie_covers_sdai_pie
properties.description: The Pot's total normalized savings Pie is at least the pie it records for sDAI (sDAI's exit can never underflow the Pot's totals).
properties.group: Share accounting is exact and fully backed

properties.title: pot_vat_dai_covers_savings
properties.description: The Pot's internal Vat dai balance is at least chi * Pie, so every unit of pie can be paid out at the current accumulator.
properties.group: Maker-side solvency assumed by sDAI holds

properties.title: daijoin_vat_dai_covers_dai_supply
properties.description: DaiJoin's internal Vat dai balance is at least RAY * DAI totalSupply, so any outstanding DAI can be joined back into the Vat (DaiJoin is the only minter of DAI).
properties.group: Maker-side solvency assumed by sDAI holds

properties.title: sdai_setup_permissions_persist
properties.description: The permissions sDAI grants in its constructor persist forever: Vat.can[sDAI][DaiJoin] == 1, Vat.can[sDAI][Pot] == 1, and DAI.allowance[sDAI][DaiJoin] == max uint256.
properties.group: Maker-side solvency assumed by sDAI holds

properties.title: transfer_moves_exact_amount
properties.description: A successful transfer(to, v) decreases the caller's balance by v and increases to's balance by v (no change when caller == to), leaves every other balance and totalSupply unchanged, and returns true.
properties.group: ERC-20 transfers move exactly what they say

properties.title: transfer_from_moves_exact_amount_and_spends_allowance
properties.description: A successful transferFrom(from, to, v) moves exactly v from from to to, leaves other balances and totalSupply unchanged, decreases allowance[from][caller] by exactly v when caller != from and the allowance is finite, and leaves it unchanged when it is max uint256 or caller == from.
properties.group: ERC-20 transfers move exactly what they say

properties.title: transfer_revert_conditions
properties.description: transfer reverts if and only if msg.value != 0, to is the zero address or the sDAI contract, or the caller's balance is below the amount: a holder can always transfer up to their balance to a valid address.
properties.group: ERC-20 transfers move exactly what they say

properties.title: transfer_from_revert_conditions
properties.description: transferFrom reverts if and only if msg.value != 0, to is invalid (zero or sDAI), from's balance is insufficient, or the caller is not from and holds a finite allowance below the amount.
properties.group: ERC-20 transfers move exactly what they say

properties.title: balance_decrease_requires_owner_or_allowance
properties.description: For every sDAI method: if an account's share balance decreases, then the caller is that account, or the caller held an allowance from it at least as large as the decrease, which is reduced by exactly the decrease unless it is infinite.
properties.group: Only owners and approved spenders move or approve shares

properties.title: allowance_increase_requires_owner_authorization
properties.description: For every sDAI method: allowance[owner][spender] can only increase when the caller is the owner (approve, increaseAllowance) or through permit for that owner; no method changes an allowance for a pair other than (caller, spender) except permit for (owner, spender) and spending by the caller as spender.
properties.group: Only owners and approved spenders move or approve shares

properties.title: allowance_management_functions_correct
properties.description: approve sets allowance[caller][spender] to value; increaseAllowance adds exactly addedValue (reverting on overflow); decreaseAllowance subtracts exactly subtractedValue and reverts when it exceeds the current allowance; none changes balances or other allowances.
properties.group: Only owners and approved spenders move or approve shares

properties.title: erc20_ops_preserve_vault_backing
properties.description: transfer, transferFrom, approve, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance never change totalSupply, the Pot pie of sDAI, or any DAI or Vat dai balance.
properties.group: ERC-20 transfers move exactly what they say

properties.title: deposit_effects_exact
properties.description: A successful deposit(assets, receiver) takes exactly assets DAI from the caller, mints shares = floor(assets * RAY / chi) to receiver (chi being the Pot accumulator after drip), increases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns shares.
properties.group: Deposit / mint / withdraw / redeem have exact effects

properties.title: mint_effects_exact
properties.description: A successful mint(shares, receiver) mints exactly shares to receiver, takes assets = ceil(shares * chi / RAY) DAI from the caller, increases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns assets.
properties.group: Deposit / mint / withdraw / redeem have exact effects

properties.title: withdraw_effects_exact
properties.description: A successful withdraw(assets, receiver, owner) delivers exactly assets DAI to receiver, burns shares = ceil(assets * RAY / chi) from owner, decreases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns shares.
properties.group: Deposit / mint / withdraw / redeem have exact effects

properties.title: redeem_effects_exact
properties.description: A successful redeem(shares, receiver, owner) burns exactly shares from owner, delivers assets = floor(shares * chi / RAY) DAI to receiver, decreases totalSupply and sDAI's Pot pie by shares, changes no other share balance, and returns assets.
properties.group: Deposit / mint / withdraw / redeem have exact effects

properties.title: rounding_favors_vault
properties.description: No sDAI method decreases the internal Vat dai held by the sDAI contract: across deposit, mint, withdraw and redeem the vault always receives at least the value it pays out (shares * chi <= assets * RAY on entry, shares * chi >= assets * RAY on exit).
properties.group: Rounding never leaks value from the vault

properties.title: round_trip_no_profit
properties.description: Within one block, depositing assets and immediately redeeming the minted shares returns at most assets; minting shares and immediately withdrawing the DAI paid burns at least those shares. No sequence of entry and exit at the same rate yields more DAI than was put in.
properties.group: Rounding never leaks value from the vault

properties.title: preview_matches_action
properties.description: In the same block and state, previewDeposit, previewMint, previewWithdraw and previewRedeem return exactly what deposit, mint, withdraw and redeem return, even when the Pot has not been dripped (the views price at the accrued rate).
properties.group: Pricing is current, consistent and manipulation-resistant

properties.title: actions_price_at_accrued_rate
properties.description: A depositor cannot buy shares at a stale (undripped) rate and capture interest that accrued before their deposit: after deposit, mint, withdraw or redeem, the Pot has been dripped to the current block (rho == block.timestamp) and the amount was computed with that post-drip chi.
properties.group: Pricing is current, consistent and manipulation-resistant

properties.title: third_party_value_unaffected
properties.description: Within one block, no sDAI call by one actor changes the DAI value (convertToAssets of balance) of another actor who is not the owner, receiver or caller of that call: going first or last gains nothing at others' expense.
properties.group: Pricing is current, consistent and manipulation-resistant

properties.title: share_price_independent_of_donations
properties.description: Sending DAI or internal Vat dai directly to the sDAI contract does not change convertToShares or convertToAssets, so the first depositor / donation inflation attack has no effect.
properties.group: Pricing is current, consistent and manipulation-resistant

properties.title: share_price_never_decreases
properties.description: With a savings rate dsr >= RAY, no sDAI operation decreases the Pot accumulator chi, so the DAI value of a share never goes down.
properties.group: Pricing is current, consistent and manipulation-resistant

properties.title: deposit_pulls_only_from_caller
properties.description: For every sDAI method, the DAI balance of any account other than the caller does not decrease (an approval to sDAI cannot be used by someone else to deposit the approver's DAI).
properties.group: Deposit / mint / withdraw / redeem have exact effects

properties.title: redeem_always_possible
properties.description: A holder with balance b can always redeem(b', receiver, self) for any b' <= b to a valid receiver (not zero, not the DAI token) when the Maker system is sound (pot covers savings, rate accumulation does not overflow), including after Pot cage.
properties.group: Holders can always exit; max functions are accurate

properties.title: max_functions_accurate
properties.description: maxRedeem(owner) == balanceOf(owner) and redeeming it succeeds; withdraw(maxWithdraw(owner)) succeeds and burns no more than the owner's balance; maxDeposit/maxMint do not exceed the amount deposit/mint accept for a caller with unlimited DAI (ERC-4626).
properties.group: Holders can always exit; max functions are accurate

properties.title: permit_effects_exact
properties.description: A successful permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, sig) sets allowance[owner][spender] = value, changes owner's nonce from n to n+1 (mod 2^256), and changes no other allowance, nonce, balance or totalSupply.
properties.group: Permit is signature-gated, replay-safe and chain-bound

properties.title: permit_rejects_expired_and_zero_owner
properties.description: permit reverts when block.timestamp > deadline or owner is the zero address.
properties.group: Permit is signature-gated, replay-safe and chain-bound

properties.title: permit_requires_owner_signature
properties.description: permit succeeds only if ecrecover over the EIP-712 digest returns owner for a 65-byte signature, or owner's isValidSignature(digest, sig) returns the EIP-1271 magic value.
properties.group: Permit is signature-gated, replay-safe and chain-bound

properties.title: nonces_change_only_by_permit
properties.description: For every sDAI method other than permit, no nonce changes; permit changes only the nonce of its owner argument, so a consumed nonce is never re-issued (short of 2^256 permits).
properties.group: Permit is signature-gated, replay-safe and chain-bound

properties.title: domain_separator_bound_to_chain
properties.description: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() returns the cached separator on the deployment chain, and on any other chain id returns a different value, so signatures cannot be replayed across a fork.
properties.group: Permit is signature-gated, replay-safe and chain-bound
